scripts.go:fmt:check: bash -c 'files=$(gofmt -l . ); [ -z "$files" ] || { echo "The following Go files are not gofmt-clean:"; echo "$files"; echo "Run: gofmt -w ."; exit 1; }'
scripts.test: npm run test:go && npm run test:frontend
scripts.check:bindings: npm run generate:bindings && git diff --quiet -- frontend/bindings || (echo 'Generated bindings are stale; run npm run generate:bindings and commit the result.' >&2 && git diff --stat -- frontend/bindings && exit 1)
scripts.check: npm run check:version && npm run build:frontend && npm run go:fmt:check && npm run go:vet && npm test && npm run check:bindings
